narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>O eigh and O C are halves of eight. But we cannot find O B, because B D is not given.
<bookmark mark='bd'/>B D is the other diagonal of the same rectangle.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>The diagonals of a rectangle are equal, so B D is known too.

narration: <bookmark mark='one'/>The diagonals of a rectangle are equal in length.
<bookmark mark='two'/>They also cut each other in half where they cross.
<bookmark mark='yours'/>Your turn. Diagonal eigh C of a rectangle is ten centimetres. How long is each of the four parts?
